name: Anime Impulse Los Angeles
blurb: Southern California stop of the touring Anime Impulse convention, held at the Fairplex in Pomona with a vendor hall, artist alley and special guests.

editions.evidence: Official poster (hero:3) and homepage/event-page text: 'ANIME IMPULSE LOS ANGELES 2027 JANUARY 16-17, 2027 FAIRPLEX 2118 N WHITE AVE. POMONA, CA 91768' and 'Jan 16-17, 2027 10AM - 7PM'.

notes: The LA event page (/los-angeles) is live and confirms Fairplex, Jan 16-17 2027. Its '#guests' section currently renders only a Google-Maps venue widget and generic promo blocks (no guest photo cards), and the main page separately shows a literal 'COMING SOON' graphic where guests will go; no dated 2027 guest subpage exists yet (past years used e.g. '/los-angeles-guests-2024', '/los-angeles-guests-2023'), so guests is 'none-yet'. Organizer is 'Impulse Universe, Inc.' per the site footer (also runs K-Play! Fest, Sneaker Expo and Collectors Expo).
